# AdaptGym source export

Source: https://github.com/flavianv/adaptgym
Revision: f8e4d939505fe06dc83484c41e096070440d4ce0
Exported `src/adaptgym/*.py` matches the executed source hashes in
`evidence/staged_source_manifest.json`. The external repository had untracked
example exporters, which were not used and are not included.

Upstream `pyproject.toml` declares `license = "MIT"` and author
`AdaptGym contributors`. Upstream has no standalone LICENSE file in this checkout.
The accompanying LICENSE reproduces the standard MIT terms under that declared
license; it is not presented as a verbatim upstream license-file export.
